name: @omakase-robotics/ui-components
description: Shared React component library for omakase-robotics web UIs (omakaseos_service web + status_server_webui + robot-inspection-web). v0.1–v0.2 status primitives, v0.3 form & layout primitives, v0.4 conversation-log primitives, v0.5 live-conversation primitives (Google Meet 1:n stage), v0.6 canonical assistant-ui primitives (Thread / Composer / MarkdownText / Tool / Reasoning / Voice — vendored from the shadcn-style assistant-ui registry, CSS Modules in-package), v0.7 AsyncCombobox (type-to-search over an async candidate list — the library's only synthetic ARIA widget, bounded by an automated boundary spec), v0.8 three vocabulary levels the shared robot console needed (--ds-text-secondary between text and muted, --ds-border-subtle below border, --ds-radius-lg above card) so a consumer no longer has to keep a private token set, v0.9 aui surface migrated off Tailwind v4 onto plain CSS Modules (same public API, no Tailwind toolchain shipped in-package), v0.10 ToggleSwitch / SignalBars / ReservedText promoted from robot-status-server-app's self-contained components/ui/ CSS modules (an SoT audit finding — three genuine L1 primitives living outside the shared design system; audio-mixer widgets deliberately left as that console's domain widgets), v0.11 the primitives the robot console still kept to itself: Spinner / Toast (three private spinner keyframes and a toast card there, another toast card on the dashboard — now presentational primitives whose timing and placement stay the host's), Panel (the titled page-grid section its 39 screens are built from, distinct from Card's surface-within-a-page), FactGrid + Fact size (the inset-tile reading of a set of facts, the missing half of the `column` direction), plus StatusBadge's opt-in `live` region, so state can be asserted by role and data-attribute instead of by its visible label, v0.12 the library's first composition rule rather than a new primitive — elevation is not nested: Panel and Card are drawn from the same border+shadow recipe, so a Card inside a Panel body drops its shadow and steps its border down to --ds-border-subtle (keeping radius and header type), applied automatically via Panel's data-panel-body scope marker so no call site changes, v0.13 tried to complete that rule by making a Card in a Panel body render as a section of it (no outline, fill, lift or corner, the frame's inset replaced by the section rhythm) through the same data-panel-body ancestor selector, and was rejected on review: an automatic context-dependent transform makes the call site lie (one call rendering as two different things depending on where it sits), and more fundamentally it repainted a violation until it looked legal, leaving the container-in-container it was meant to prevent in place and normalized, v0.14 keeps that look and drops that mechanism — the nesting is refused rather than restyled (Panel opens a React context around its children and Card, or another Panel, throws when composed inside it, in production as in development, naming the alternative) and Section is that alternative: a new primitive holding a heading, its content and the rhythm around it with no surface at all (0 across so its heading aligns with the panel's own title, --ds-space-xl down so two sections stand twice their largest internal gap apart, stated as each section's own padding because in the consumer sibling sections are not reliably adjacent siblings in the DOM), rendering identically inside a Panel and outside one, and sharing its header implementation with CardHeader because a card is a section drawn on a surface, v0.15 a THIRD host and the vocabulary it forced: the acceptance-inspection app (robot-inspection-web) ships one dark, fully desaturated theme by design, so a register cannot be stated as a hue -- aliases/robot-inspection-web.css is the first alias authored under the alias-purity guard and therefore carries no bare literals at all (the host's --ri-* palette owns every value, geometry included), and three new Status primitives state meaning through shape instead: StatusGlyph (five registers separated by fill, line style and mark -- washed ring + check, solid disc + cross, dashed ring + bang, solid empty ring + dash, dashed empty ring), RankChip (three levels ordered by weight -- filled, outlined, dashed + muted -- with the rank driving the weight and the caller writing the notation, so renaming A/B/C to high/mid/low does not restyle anything), and SegmentedMeter (a fixed whole divided into ordered tiers of the surface's own ink at 90/55/30/16%, with weight required per segment rather than derived from position and the denominator taken as max(total, sum) so an over-full meter widens the whole instead of rendering as exactly full); plus the two token levels they needed -- --ds-tone-idle-* as a sixth register ('no reading has been taken yet', which neutral's 'does not apply' cannot say, deliberately NOT widening BadgeTone since no badge or toast states it) and --ds-radius-chip below control (a 24px tile rounded at a generous host's 12px control radius is a pill, and a pill is not a tile), both bridged into the two existing aliases in the same change.

scripts.build: bun run build:aui && bun run build:demo
